title: Boating Day Turns into Parents’ Worst Nightmare
description:
Arizona police responded to a 911 call on the water after Alyssa and Mathew Wroblewski said they found their infant unresponsive after briefly jumping in the water at Lake Havasu. The child was rushed to the hospital, prompting an investigation that ultimately concluded with no charges for the Wroblewskis. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
